name: gnosis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Inner Door of self-knowledge which separates the pneumatic spark from the planetary spheres

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the descent of the Light-Man into the material realm

TANCH.justification: The Mind of Sovereignty that contains and terminates all emanations

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of the soul as it sheds planetary influences

AREV.justification: The contravariant movement of the Light-Man into the garment of flesh and destiny

CLINK.justification: The sequential composition of spiritual states and material forms

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity operation where the spark recognizes its own divine nature

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the unified Light-Man into the reflecting subject and the reflected object

FFUSE.chosen_element: The Marriage of Prometheus and Epimetheus
FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of mind and body into a single pneumatic unity

EVALT.justification: The affirmative realization of the pneumatic essence

EVALF.justification: The false identification with the passions and the material body

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being in the world but not of it where fate and freedom coexist

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the soul's realization in the eternal record

phase_2.fuse_element: The Marriage of Prometheus and Epimetheus

phase_3.void_description: The abyss of non-being before the first emanation of light
phase_3.true_description: The pneumatic state of liberation and gnosis
phase_3.false_description: The hylic state of ignorance and subjection to fate
phase_3.both_description: The psychic state of the initiate holding the tension of the dual nature

steps.domain_action: The pre-cosmic silence precedes all naming and manifestation
The Light-Man descends into the lower realms of matter
The soul binds itself to the planetary spheres of the Hebdomad
The garment of Adam-of-Fate becomes a fixed biological reality
The unified consciousness splits into the observer and the observed world
The counterfeit daimon leads the soul into the error of material identification
The initiate reaches the Inner Door where fate and spirit meet
The spark achieves self-recognition within the darkness
The true Son of God emerges from the psychic confusion
The soul begins the ascent through the planetary gates
The mind and body reunite in a perfected pneumatic state
The soul returns to the terminal anchor of Poemandres

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos which translates divine will into cosmic structure
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The breath or pneuma that carries information between the soul and the stars
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The anamnesis or recollection of the soul's celestial origin
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Great Year and the cycles of the planetary governors
phase_5.alfs_store: The Corpus Hermeticum and the teachings of Zosimos

phase_6.cycle_cost: The psychic energy of attention and the shedding of material desires
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The soul scattered and lost in the multiplicity of fate
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The soul gathered and unified in the singularity of gnosis
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The process is a closed cycle of descent and return where the original light is fully recovered
